tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Make an account and an API token, with no email and no human. Needs no token. Nothing is sent to the email address; it names the account. Returns api_token (and a generated password for the web app).

tools.name: send_for_signing
tools.description: Upload a PDF, place the fields for each person, and get a signing link for each one. Nothing is emailed: send each signing_url to its own person yourself.

tools.name: get_envelope
tools.description: The status of an envelope (DRAFT, PENDING, COMPLETED, REJECTED, CANCELLED), each person's signing and read status, and the signing link of each person who has not signed yet.

tools.name: download_document
tools.description: Download a PDF of an envelope: the signed document (once COMPLETED), the original, the signing certificate or the audit log. Returned as an embedded PDF resource.

tools.name: cancel_envelope
tools.description: Cancel a pending envelope: its signing links stop working. Nobody is told; tell them yourself.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_account" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
